derivation: Repeated equal-fraction interpolation gives (1-t)²A+2t(1-t)B+t²C. Nonnegative weights sum to one on [0,1], proving control-triangle containment. Endpoints follow at t=0,1. Derivative 2[(1-t)(B-A)+t(C-B)] generally has nonconstant norm.
limitations: The middle control handle is not generally on the curve. Constant parameter speed does not imply constant arc-length speed.
